settings.heading: Shaving gear built differently.
settings.lede: We wanted a razor that works as well as the expensive ones and costs far less. Over a decade later, that is still the brief.
settings.image_alt: Man shaving at a bathroom mirror
Combs, scissors and tins laid out on a table
settings.heading: Thoughtful products for all men.
settings.text: Hundreds of engineers, designers, chemists and craftspeople work on razors, body care, skin and hair. The goal is the same across the shelf: do the job well and keep the price honest.

settings.title: Performance first
settings.text: If it does not shave closer or feel better, it does not ship.

settings.title: A fair price
settings.text: We sell direct and show the price on every card.

settings.title: Plain talk
settings.text: Claims are specific, ingredients are public and the guarantee is simple.

settings.quote: “We were tired of paying for packaging and brand. So we asked around, learned how razors are made and built one that was simply good.”
settings.note: Two friends, one stubborn question about overpriced razors.
